featured_reviews.name: Swapnil A.
featured_reviews.review_text:
A quite and pretty dining experience!

Spice is a pretty restaurant with beautiful ambience and great service. I went there for lunch but found the menu to be very limited. So for a restaurant inside a hotel having a small menu may be fine but not otherwise, you can find even small restaurants service you ample choices. Coming to the food it was good not great, their chinese appetizer was good but the pasta was pretty basic and bland so was their complimentary mocktail. So may be my experience wasn't that great with food but hoping other things must be good cz overall their quality of food was great. One thing to point out is their portion sizes, they are huge which was a surprise cz almost all good places have slowly started to reduce theirs, so I will advice you to order seeing it for yourself.

One strange thing that happened was they first told that the order will take 25 mins which was usual for any place but then they got it in 5 mins, so I don't know what their usual speed is. But the staff was good and the service too. The place had multiple types of seating areas and its quite well spaced out as well. So its a good fine dine experience, but i will advice you to check the menu before you go, I just hope they improve/increase their menu! Also its is generally pricier considering its inside a prime hotel, but they usually have good discounts via swiggy & zomato so do check it out!

If you visit please comment and tell what you ordered and how it was, so I can think of going back!

featured_reviews.name: IMRAN ABBAS SYED
featured_reviews.review_text:
Had a wonderful dining experience at Spice It, Ibis (Vikhroli) with my family of 6.

The ambience is too good—pleasant, spacious, and very comfortable for family dining.

We tried a variety of dishes including:
Tangra Style Chilli Chicken
Spice It Paneer Tikka
Chicken Tikka Masala
Mix Vegetable

Special mention to Jabir, who is truly an asset to the hotel—exceptional service, very courteous, and attentive throughout. Praful was also very polite and supportive.

Overall, a great experience with excellent food, ambience, and service. Highly recommended! 🌟

featured_reviews.name: Ajay
featured_reviews.review_text:
Usually, I’ve had a good experience at Ibis Spice it and enjoyed both the food and drinks, which is why my recent visit was extremely disappointing.

We had booked a table through Zomato, which included 2 complimentary mocktails. The first one was served properly, but for the second, they simply poured a tiny amount into a much smaller glass instead of making a fresh drink. I understand they were complimentary, but such cheap treatment towards guests is honestly embarrassing. If complimentary drinks are an issue, it’s better to be upfront about it.

I had also ordered a Mojito, and honestly, it was one of the worst Mojitos I’ve ever had. The mint leaves were just floating around without being properly prepared, the drink itself was served almost at room temperature instead of being chilled, and there were multiple lemon seeds inside the glass. It felt very poorly made and completely ruined the experience. My stomach got upset not sure because of the food and drinks I had but I had upset stomach the next day.

The service overall was extremely poor. Every food order took around 30-40 minutes even after repeatedly reminding the staff. It genuinely felt like nobody cared about the guests or what had been ordered.

The worst part was the billing. After requesting the bill, we had to wait nearly 40 minutes despite asking multiple times. By the end, I was exhausted and frustrated. I didn’t want to create a scene, but the staff seemed completely indifferent. We finally left the restaurant around 1:20 AM.

This was honestly one of the worst dining experiences I’ve had. I even informed the manager about everything before leaving. Really disappointed and hope the management seriously works on their service.

featured_reviews.review_text: During our stay at Ibis, we dined at Spice IT and tried the Crispy Chicken Wings, Aglio Olio Pasta, Grilled Prawns, and Chicken Green Thai Curry. featured_reviews.review_text:
Our inaugural visit to Lake View Café was, regrettably, underwhelming despite its promising premise.

The buffet boasted an impressively expansive spread, encompassing Southeast Asian, Indian, and continental cuisines, reflecting commendable variety and ambition. However, the execution fell short of expectation, with the offerings lacking any discernible “wow” factor.

A particularly notable drawback was the quality of the chicken across several dishes, which appeared less than fresh and was consistently tough, detracting significantly from the dining experience. Even relatively straightforward preparations, such as the pasta, required multiple iterations before reaching an acceptable standard—an avoidable lapse in a setting of this calibre.

Service, too, proved to be disappointingly pedestrian, falling well below the benchmark set by establishments such as JW Marriott Mumbai and Taj Mahal Palace.

In sum, while the breadth of the spread is undeniably impressive, the inconsistency in execution and lacklustre service rendered the experience far from memorable.

featured_reviews.review_text:
Ruined Evening – Terrible Service & Absolute Lack of Basic Etiquette
​Rating: 1/5 stars
​We had an incredibly frustrating experience at Pop Tate's. While the food was okay, the service was outright appalling and completely ruined our evening.
​We arrived when the restaurant was busy, but even after it emptied out, we ended up sitting there for almost three hours due to pure negligence.
​The Food and the Missing Ingredients:
We ordered the jalapeno cheese balls, but they were served completely missing the jalapeno. When we pointed this out, the server offered to replace it with an avocado alternative... which never even arrived.
​The 1-Hour Delay & Lazy Excuses:
I had to follow up with our server three times about our order. After waiting for over an hour, the server's explanation was that the KOT (Kitchen Order Ticket) hadn't printed in the kitchen. What makes this unacceptable is that the server lacked the basic courtesy to check on the delay or inform us beforehand. I eventually had to ask a completely different server just to find out what was happening, and nobody seemed to have a clue. This is exceptionally poor etiquette from the service team.
​Frustrating "Apology":
At the end of the night, the head server came over with a complimentary pastry to apologize. We politely declined, explaining that the team had already ruined our evening and that they needed to train their staff to pay attention to tables and anticipate guest needs. Instead of listening, the server didn't even apologize verbally and simply brought the pastry again after we had already denied it. This just added to our frustration.
​Final Verdict:
Throughout the night, the servers were completely preoccupied chit-chatting with each other instead of managing their tables. I highlighted this directly to the head server. This branch desperately needs strong, strict supervision and heavy retraining for its staff. I sincerely hope management takes this seriously and improves in the near future, but as of now, I cannot recommend this place.

featured_reviews.review_text:
If you are looking for the perfect spot for a night out in Powai, Eve is a total standout. We recently hosted a party here, and it exceeded every expectation.
​The Vibe
​The first thing you notice is the stunning library-themed decor. It’s sophisticated and upscale, but once the evening progresses, the energy shifts perfectly into a high-energy party atmosphere. The transition from a chic dining space to a lively venue is seamless.
​Food & Drinks
​The menu is impressively diverse. We had a mix of Asian and Continental dishes—the sushi and dim sum were incredibly fresh, and the small plates are perfect for sharing in a group setting. The cocktail program is also top-notch; the mixologists really know their craft.
​Service
​The staff handled our group with total professionalism. Even with a packed house, the service was prompt, and they went out of their way to ensure the celebration went smoothly.
​Bottom Line: Whether it’s a corporate mixer, a birthday, or just a big get-together with friends, Eve offers the right balance of class and fun. Easily one of the best spots in the neighborhood right now!

Visited on a rainy monsoon day. The waiter was informative and very helpful. I had hot mushroom soup, a Manzo (panini), followed by Kahwa (Kashmiri, hot, tea). Wonderful. Am definitely visiting again, hopefully with friends.

My second visit : Had a leisurely late lunch on a Sunday afternoon - ordered Scallopine De Maiale Alla Romana, followed by a pot of Tranquil Berry (green tea). Very nice. Read and took photos. Very pleasant.

My third visit : Came for a late rainy Sunday lunch in November, and ordered a freshly made Cream of Mushroom soup, my favoured Scallopine De Maiale Alla Romana, and a pot of hibiscus flavoured Tranquil Berry  tea….It was as expected - nice, with a relaxing, quiet space, even on a Sunday late afternoon. A very nice experience. A lovely place for social dining.

Loved it definitely. The setup is very pretty and the Italian bit is definitely worth it. Would definitely visit this place again.

featured_reviews.name: An0nym0use
featured_reviews.review_text:
The place is so much better in terms of seating where people are not cramped. One of the perks to find in Mumbai.

The place wasn’t crowded, but we still made a reservation only to realise that really doesn’t mean anything. We still were not properly greeted and made to wait for long.

Now apart from those inconveniences, the food was nice and a safe backup.
Tried a mushroom starter which sounded much better in the menu than in real. The pizza was just normal nothing special but the base and crust were so much better than you could generally find. The brownie milkshake was good and thick.

Just a nice backup in case you can’t think of another one. But not something to visit to try good food.
